metas.name: Sooryan
metas.description: Sooryan is an aspiring singer just like his father. However, he realises that his journey to become a famous singer will not be easy due to his father's debts.

metas.name: His Highness Abdullah
metas.description: The story follows Abdullah (Mohanlal) who is hired by the members of a wealthy royal family to assassinate the family head Maharaja Udayavarma (Nedumudi Venu). Abdullah comes into the royal palace under the disguise Ananthan Namboothiri, a classical singer, and tries to use this mask to softly kill the Maharaja.

metas.name: Kamboji
metas.description: An extremely passionate kathakali artiste falls in love with a mohiniyattam artiste and their blossoming affair gives rise to a new and unique form of art.

metas.name: Rock N' Roll
metas.description: Chandramouli, an international drummer, goes to Chennai to help his friend in his new project. However, his life turns upside down when he falls in love with a playback singer.

metas.name: Naam
metas.description: A group of six guys and three girls who meet in college become thick friends and eventually take their friendship beyond the classroom and the campus. All goes well for the group until they are faced with sudden crisis. The event strengthens the group's bond as they struggle hard to overcome the situation.

metas.name: Gnanambika
metas.description: Jnanambika, the heroine of the film, is the daughter of a wealthy landlord, Rajasekharan. After the death of her mother, her father marries again. Rajamani, the villainous second wife tortures Jnanambika, forcing her to run away from home.

metas.name: Hey Googly
metas.description: 'Karal' a newly married bride, discovering her new surroundings and finding tricky ways to outsmart the rest. Over a course of time she discovers passion and love.

metas.name: Amen
metas.description: Solomon, who belongs to a band, is in love with Soshanna, who hails from an upper class family. The story spells how Solomon manages to win over all the obstacles to marry Soshanna.

metas.name: Ingane Oru Nilapakshi
metas.description: The story revolves around Uma who wrongly assumes that her love is reciprocated by Charly, the happy-go-lucky boy she grows up with. She realizes her mistake when Charly leaves to learn music and returns with Manasi the girl who sings with him. Uma then decides to be independent of Charly. But very soon Charly too starts realising Uma's place in his life.

metas.name: Sopanam
metas.description: This film tells the story of a singer who loves his teacher's daughter.

metas.name: Rakkuyilin Ragasadassil
metas.description: Well-known musician Viswanathan was in love with his college mate and a dancer Janani. After facing opposition from all quarters, they finally get married. But soon their ego and professional jealousy start causing problems in their life making Viswanathan leave home with their son. Years later, Janani is to receive the Natyasree award in dance and he challenges her to dance to his voice.

metas.name: Ramanan
metas.description: Ramanan  and Madanan  are the two shepherds who are bosom pals. Meek and handsome, Ramanan used to sing and play the flute as he led the flock to the pastures Chandrika , the daughter of the wealthy Advocate Peshkar  gets fascinated by the charming shepherd with the sweet voice. Madanan warns Ramanan about the treacherous ways of the wealthy and advises him to keep away from Chandrika. But Ramanan is blinded by his love for Chandrika.

metas.name: Sabarimala Sree Ayyappan
metas.description: King Rajasekhara, the king of Pandalam, finds a child on the banks of River Pampa during one of his hunting expeditions. A saint who appears there advises the king to adopt this child name him as Manikantan

metas.name: Bharya Oru Manthri
metas.description: The film stars Menaka, Sukumaran, Anuradha and Balan K. Nair in the lead roles.

metas.name: Devadoothan
metas.description: Vishal Krishnamoorthy, a renowned music composer and singer, reminisces about his initial struggles and an unknown spirit that inspires him to compose songs.

metas.name: Banaras
metas.description: Hari, a village boy, travels to Varanasi to pursue higher studies. However, he falls into trouble after he unintentionally cheats on his girlfriend, Devu, with his classmate, Amritha.

metas.name: Ormayundo Ee Mukham
metas.description: Gautham is a young and successful businessman. His life dramatically changes when he meets Nithya, a girl who is suffering from a short-term memory loss.

metas.name: Pokkuveyil
metas.description: A young artist lives with his father, a radical friend and music loving young woman. His father dies, the radical friend leaves him and the woman is taken away by her family to another city.

metas.name: Saigal Padukayanu
metas.description: The movie revolves around Chandra Babu, who has a great passion for music which he has inherited from his father.

metas.name: Kumara Sambhavam
metas.description: Kumara Sambhavam is based on the epic poem of the poet Kalidasa of the same name.

metas.name: Return
metas.description: A musical video that flashes the old college memories of a student

metas.name: Sasidharan
metas.description: Sashidharan, the graduate son of the landlord Panikker falls in love with Vilasini, the daughter of a poor widow Kalyani Amma . A crooked local newspaper editor and the lecherous city wastrel Rajasekharan form a tricky plot turning Panikker against his sons wish to marry Vilasini.

metas.name: Poomaram
metas.description: The film is based on the Mahatma Gandhi University Youth Festival which takes place every year, where different colleges under the university participate for winning the champion trophy.

metas.name: Mehfil
metas.description: Based on the life of Mullassery Raju, the story unfolds over a single night of music, exploring love, relationships, and the resilience of a man who hides his pain to bring joy and unity to those around him.
